protocol.stopping: Oracle source-ID stopping after a read; not autonomous answer sufficiency. Controls never succeed.
protocol.read_semantics: Logical document reads from frozen cached snapshots; zero HTTP reads inside harness.
protocol.policies: FIFO, BM25 and Laya preserve all unchosen frontier edges; strictLaya only sees current-node outgoing edges.

cache_validation.meaning: Exact-state warm lookup, not unseen-query latency

limitations: Twenty-four fixed public cases, not a random independent sample; named cases share one repository root.
Oracle target-ID stopping does not assess autonomous answer sufficiency or absence detection.
Strict policy shares the process cache with frontier policy; per-policy new calls are not independent cold costs.
Logical cached reads exclude Confluence network latency and synchronization overhead.
Peak process RSS excludes a separately measured MPS peak; 4GB hardware not tested.
No private Notion publication, new answer-generation calls, or proven net-dollar savings.
